notes: Fresh-state Stern MPU-200 solenoid test. Four Self Test presses held 600 ms (burn-in, lamp test, display test, solenoid test) reach the solenoid test, which pulses one driver at a time and shows its driver-position (SDU Q) number on the player displays, so each printed solenoid number pairs with the public address that fires. The first press is repeated until the burn-in's first solenoid pulse proves the ROM accepted it.

actions.label: self test press 1 (burn-in, repeated until public solenoid 1 proves it started)
